scope: Configuration-specific audit of the files selected by the pinned Android ARM64 software build. No game, firmware, or prebuilt dependency is included. This engineering record is not legal advice.
aggregateConclusion: Blocked. The selected build combines GPL-2.0-or-later code with legacy SoftFloat 2b terms containing additional indemnification and responsibility clauses. Compatibility with EmuFusion's GPLv3 combined distribution has not been established.

components.evidence: The project license and primary emulator source notices grant GPL version 2 or, at the recipient's option, any later version.
The selected legacy SoftFloat 2b header carries custom terms, including indemnification and responsibility conditions beyond a standard permissive grant.

blockingGates: Replace the legacy SoftFloat implementation with a GPL-compatible component or obtain documented legal clearance.
